items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 5:30pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 5:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry, with clear intervals this evening and early tonight. Light to moderate west or southwest winds, and temperatures falling to 2 or 3°C.

Becoming cloudier soon after midnight with a few showers before dawn, and a minimum temperature of 2 or 3°C. Variable cloud and occasional showers for the remainder of the day. Light to moderate southwest winds, gradually increasing fresh to strong. Maximum temperature of 11°C.

Comments: Strong winds developing.


##Outlook##

A band of rain will arrive around midnight, with spells of rain continuing through the morning and turning heavy at times. This will gradually peter out through the afternoon, leaving some clear intervals and only isolated showers. Fresh to strong, mainly southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering north or northwest. Winds will strengthen further later in the day and into the evening again, bringing a risk of gales for a time. Maximum temperature 10°C.
